prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop homepage north-star comp for an Arabic RTL cinema magazine
Primary request: Redesign the Mazaq Cinema homepage as “The Critic’s Screening Room,” an editor-led cinematic reading experience. Preserve the reference image’s real brand identity—near-black cinematic stage, warm cream text, restrained projector-gold accent, centered gold film-reel logo, Arabic-first RTL typography, full-bleed film stills—but replace its existing layout completely.
Structure: 1440×1000 desktop website viewport. Keep a slim dark header. First viewport is a decisive asymmetric editorial composition, not a standard hero: one dominant feature film still occupying roughly two thirds, with a large connected Arabic headline and short editorial rationale over a deep readable gradient; beside it, a narrow vertical “program” rail containing exactly three related editorial picks with small stills and concise titles. The bottom of the viewport visibly begins a warm-paper section titled “اختيارات هذا الأسبوع” with one wide lead article and two supporting stories, proving the page continues. A subtle film-strip edge/perforation may frame the stage once, but avoid decorative repetition. Gold appears only on the primary reading action and active focus signal.
Text (verbatim where visible): logo/brand “مذاق سينما”; dominant headline “جماليات العنف في السينما الكورية: ثورة التسعينات”; supporting heading “ما يستحق القراءة بعده”; next section “اختيارات هذا الأسبوع”; primary action “اقرأ المقال”.
Style/medium: polished production-grade web UI mockup, real editorial photography, sophisticated Arabic magazine art direction, restrained cinematic atmosphere, sharply resolved typography and spacing.
Composition/framing: RTL, wide landscape UI screenshot, content dense enough to feel complete but with generous editorial rhythm; hierarchy must be legible at a glance.
Color palette: #0B0B0E, #16161B, #F7F4ED, #EAE6DC, rare #C9A227, quiet #D4C9A8.
Constraints: preserve the reference only for brand chrome, palette, typography character, and film-image treatment; do not copy its hero/card arrangement. No invented commercial claims. No English UI. No carousel, no modal, no floating popup, no generic same-size card grid, no glassmorphism, no red Netflix styling, no gradient text, no tracked/disconnected Arabic letters, no excessive rounded cards, no watermark.
approval: Delegated by the user through ‘do recommended option’ and confirmed by the subsequent craft request.
